blind: Cases H1–H4 and keys are withheld from candidate author. Reviewer sees only source and frozen draft; no arm label or key. Sessions isolated. Synthetic free-text drafts and two retrospective native checkpoints are separately reported.
constraints: Same controller, bridge, models, goals, roster composition, source and draft; isolated review change only. No context-memory feature, forced decision or automatic merge.
diagnostic: Track independent review verdict plus missing prerequisites; wider claim has no author-declared dependency and no observer needs in controlled drafts to isolate review contribution. Historical native drafts retain their actual needs. Count rework only if observed; real token usage if available; no market claim.
primary: Per arm: 8 eligible limited observations and 8 unsupported claims across 4 held-out cases repeated twice. Count false block and false pass after native synthesis. Candidate adoption requires >=2 fewer false blocks, zero false passes, no increase in false blocks on any case summed over the two repeats; all native receipt and scope checks pass. Tie, insufficient or failed quality gates => keep current.
